title_en: Visions of the Future (9/20): Looking Backward at the Future
note_en: 直到…才… means "not until": 直到公元二零零零年才醒来 "he doesn't wake up until the year 2000." English puts the negative on the verb ("doesn't wake up until"), but Chinese uses no negative at all; 才 signals that the event happened later than expected. Saying 直到二零零零年醒来 without 才 would sound incomplete.
